summary: Iter 232h + 232i review: SEC-001/002 chat authorization + email leak fixes verified via live curl-driven pytest against the preview URL, all 3 bonus-picks API endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE) work end-to-end for a real commissioner, and non-commissioner is correctly denied with 403. All 32 pre-existing local pytest guards (test_iter232h_security_fixes, test_iter232i_bonus_picks, test_iter232i_engine_ordering) pass. Frontend BonusPicksSection data-testids are validated by the existing frontend-structure guards in test_iter232i_bonus_picks.py. Live browser walkthrough could not surface the Edit Draft dialog because the Draft management screen is nested under League Administration rather than the top-level 'Draft' sidebar section (which routes to Draft Board/Room/History) — a path-navigation quirk, not a code bug.

issues: Commissioner-side Draft tab discoverability: /commissioner top tabs are Season Management/Waivers/Trades/Teams/Premium — the Draft management page (with Scheduled Drafts + Edit Draft dialog that hosts BonusPicksSection) is reached via 'League Administration' rather than the sidebar 'Draft' group which routes to end-user Draft Board/Room/History. action_items: None — all 11 live integration tests + all 32 pre-existing local guards pass. SEC-001, SEC-002 verified via live curl. Bonus picks add+delete round-trip verified against a real commissioner-owned draft in the preview DB.

critical_code_review_comments: draft_bonus_picks.py: solid guardrails — commissioner-only auth, current_pick check prevents inserting into already-drafted position, position-mode dispatch (end_of_round + overall) both clamped/validated, downstream shift of existing bonus picks + draft_picks collection is atomic. Nice touch snapshotting team_name/team_abbr onto the bonus entry so renames don't corrupt the draft board.

chat.py: _is_league_member / _require_league_member / _require_channel_access are consistently applied to every channel endpoint (list, list-messages, post-messages, mark-read, mute). SEC-002 members endpoint no longer projects email — verified over live API. Global admin correctly NOT auto-treated as a league member (defense in depth).

service-worker.js + AuthContext.logout(): PURGE_API_CACHE message + /api/users/me/* moved to NEVER_CACHE is a clean SEC-003 fix. Note: preview SW may not be registered in dev mode, so behavior is covered via the pytest guard `test_logout_sends_purge_message_to_service_worker` (PASSED).

draft_engine.get_team_for_pick with bonus_picks: correctly subtracts prior-bonus count before running snake formula. Engine ordering guards (6/6 PASSED) cover exact-match, downstream shift, multi-bonus stacking.
